# Brief Matcher
> Paste a scene brief, get ranked That Boy Hi Hat track recommendations — algorithmic estimates, UNVERIFIED, not human curation.

Client-side brief-to-track matcher over the CWI catalog. Scores on tags x3 / title x2 / synonym x2. Every score is labeled UNVERIFIED; VERIFIED playlist badges link to trust-log proof pages.

## Live
- App: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-brief-matcher/
- Try it: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-brief-matcher/?brief=dark%20trap%20fight%20scene

## Features
- Client-side scoring engine (scoring.js, zero dependencies)
- UNVERIFIED label on every algorithmic score
- VERIFIED badges link to trust-log proof pages
- ?brief= deep links
- 15/15 tests

## Machine-readable
- sample_brief: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-brief-matcher/?brief=dark%20trap%20fight%20scene

## Honest limits
Scores are algorithmic estimates, not human curation. Clearance is NOT pre-cleared here — contact hp@cumulativeweb.com.
